title: SOCIAL-004 Comment Runtime Admission
purpose: Define the minimum authoritative inputs W05 must have before Comment/Reply runtime can be admitted. This contract does not create a transport or grant production runtime admission.

authoritativeInputs.name: contentAuthority
authoritativeInputs.rule: Comment runtime must only operate on an authoritative Content record; no second Content authority may be introduced.

authoritativeInputs.name: blockPolicy
authoritativeInputs.rule: Block takes precedence over Comment visibility/interaction where applicable; client cannot supply the decision.

authoritativeInputs.name: moderationDecision
authoritativeInputs.required: when moderation decision exists or is required by Comment lifecycle
authoritativeInputs.rule: W06 owns moderation decisions; W05 owns Comment state storage; moderation fields are not duplicated into Comment.

authoritativeInputs.name: antiAbuse
authoritativeInputs.rule: Endpoint/resource/account/device/IP abuse checks must pass before authoritative Comment write.

runtimeRules: W05 must derive authorUserId from the authenticated server principal and never trust a client-supplied author identifier.
A non-null parentCommentId must resolve to a Comment within the same contentId scope.
Create Comment requires Idempotency-Key; retries with the same mutation identity must converge.
Comment visibility must be evaluated server-side before list/create.
No synchronous counter, feed, search or notification write is part of Comment's authoritative transaction.
Comment state writes remain in D1-02; W06 moderation decisions remain in D1-03.
Missing, stale or contradictory policy input fails closed.
blockingConditions: No runtime route is admitted by this contract.
Comment-specific visibility/block/mute executable decision input remains unverified.
Comment moderation coverage and W06→Comment decision consumption remain unverified.
W05 runtime, concurrency/security tests, remote D1 evidence and Evidence Registry admission remain pending.
evidenceRequired: trusted W01/W02 principal and AccountState evidence
